findings.evidence: roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/SpinStructure/README.md:392-401 'Define `IsG1G2Decomposition g K G W` … define `fromG1G2` … with `fromG1G2_isDecomposition` … should be named and shaped to match them'; README.md:408-411 keeps `IsPolarizedDecomposition` explicitly separate. Precedent: `IsF1F2Decomposition` / `fromF1F2` / `fromF1F2_isDecomposition` at Tensors/Basic.lean:613,620,632; the collision target is Polarized/Basic.lean:178.
findings.fix: Rename to `IsG1G2Decomposition`, `fromG1G2`, `fromG1G2_isDecomposition` (the `Polarized.` prefix is redundant inside `namespace Polarized` anyway).
findings.issue: `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` (155), `fromAlternatingCoefficients` (167) and `fromAlternatingCoefficients_isDecomposition` (173) do not match the API they are declared to be the analogue of, and `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` is confusable with the distinct, already-existing `Polarized.IsPolarizedDecomposition` (`∀ x Q2, A = (g1 + g2) • A`) in the same namespace; `fromAlternatingCoefficients` also reads as if the coefficients were alternating, when it is the structures that are.

findings.evidence: Same conclusion shape named `fromF1F2_conserved_left`/`fromF1F2_conserved_right` at Tensors/Basic.lean:639,647; the proof terms are `AlternatingMap.bilinMap_apply_left_eq_zero`/`_right_eq_zero` (Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/Alternating/BilinMap.lean:70,76), both of which carry `_eq_zero`. Naming conventions: 'the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion'.
findings.fix: Use `structureOne_conserved_left` / `_conserved_right` (etc.), matching the in-repo analogue, or `structureOne_apply_q_left_eq_zero` matching the lemma each proof invokes.
findings.issue: `structureOne_q_left` (118), `structureOne_q_right` (123), `structureTwo_q_left` (128), `structureTwo_q_right` (133) name only the argument `q`, not the conclusion `= 0`; a reader cannot tell the statement from the name.

findings.evidence: Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66-72 already declares `S` in `PolarizedKinematics`; Spin.lean:89,97,108,118,… all take a free `EPS` parameter and the field `EPS` (line 78) has no use site. Roadmap §0.2 (README.md:364-365) asks only for 'a chosen alternating four-form ε', not a new kinematics record.
findings.fix: Rename to `OrientedPolarizedKinematics` (or drop the record and keep passing `EPS : V [⋀^Fin 4]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ` alongside `PolarizedKinematics g`, which is what every declaration already does).
findings.issue: `SpinKinematics` advertises spin, but the spin vector `S` is already a field of `PolarizedKinematics`; the only thing this record adds is the orientation four-form. The name tells a reader nothing about what distinguishes it, and no declaration in the file ever reads `K.EPS` (each takes its own `EPS` argument), so the name promises data the API does not use.

findings.evidence: `StructureFunctions` with fields `g1`, `g2` is declared in the same namespace `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Polarized` at Polarized/Basic.lean:28,35,38,41; descriptive precedent `transverseMetric`/`pTransverse` at Tensors/Basic.lean:615-616.
findings.fix: Rename to `spinStructureOne` / `spinStructureTwo` (or `alternatingStructureOne`/`Two`), updating `_apply`, `_isAlt` and the conservation lemmas; the unpolarised analogues are named descriptively (`transverseMetric`, `pTransverse`).
findings.issue: `structureOne` / `structureTwo` (89, 97) are ambiguous with the *structure functions* `StructureFunctions.g1`/`g2` of the same namespace — 'the first structure' in polarised DIS prose normally means `g₁`, not the covariant tensor `E₁`.

summary: The decomposition predicate and constructor ignore both the roadmap-prescribed names and the `IsF1F2Decomposition`/`fromF1F2` precedent they claim to mirror, and `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` sits one word away from the unrelated existing `IsPolarizedDecomposition` in the same namespace. The conservation lemmas also name the argument instead of the conclusion, and `SpinKinematics` misdescribes what it adds.
